edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute that is the subject of this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] within 14 days after this Agreement has been executed by all parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by the Plaintiff.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon the Plaintiff's receipt of the full settlement payment in cleared funds, the Plaintiff releases the Defendant from claims arising from the dispute that is the subject of this Agreement. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or to rights to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers, as required by law, or as necessary to enforce this Agreement.
